commitMessage:
Readable audit log for administrators

Laporan > Audit now turns the server audit log into sentences such as
'Reseller Solo mengubah perangkat Avanza Budi' with the actor's name and
account type, time in WIB grouped by day, and the IP address. Linking
shows both sides ('menautkan perangkat X ke pengguna Y'), reports show
their type and period, deleted objects are marked as such.

- Filters: free-text search, actor, activity group (sign-ins, data
  changes, access links, commands, reports) and 'sensitive only'.
- Sensitive entries are highlighted: deletions and failed sign-ins in
  red; commands, link changes, server settings, counter resets, API
  tokens and device edits by non-admins in orange.
- Export to Excel, 150 entries at a time with 'show more', and a layout
  that works the same on phones and desktop.
